marco_lli: Hey — tried to apply a discount token during checkout and got `Code invalid or expired`. Token is `DISCOUNT-DELTA-2026`. worked for a teammate last week. Can someone check?
jen-support: Sorry about that — can you confirm the exact email on the account you used to apply it and a screenshot (or the error text)?
marco_lli: account email is marco@acme-apps.com. Error exactly: `Error: voucher_redeem_failed (invalid_or_expired)` screenshot attached. No special characters copied, tried uppercase/lowercase.
jen-support: thanks. A few quick checks while i look: 1) did you try applying from billing page vs during payment? 2) was the payment method already attached? 3) is this a new account?
marco_lli: applied on the billing page (Account → Billing → Apply voucher). Payment method on file yes. account created 2025-11-08.
jen-support: trying to reproduce — looking up token `DISCOUNT-DELTA-2026` in our voucher service. tagging billing: @jordan-billing for voucher lookup and redemption history.
jordan-billing: jumping in. I see the token in the ledger but it's marked `redeemed` on 1773580000 by acct_0a9Z... which is a different email (marco+old@acme-apps.com). Might be single-use and was consumed. Do you have alternate emails or aliases?
marco_lli: hmm that's odd — we sometimes use aliases, but the teammate said they never used it. Could that be assigned to a different account by mistake?
jordan-billing: possible. Two things we can do: 1) if token was consumed inadvertently, we can either 1-for-1 reissue or manually credit your account with the same value (we need approval because of fraud controls), 2) if the other acct is yours (alias), we can transfer. Which do you prefer?
marco_lli: prefer manual credit to marco@acme-apps.com so I can finish onboarding. amount was $75 discount.
jen-support: under our escalation flow i'll request a manual credit. @sara-se from security/eligibility — can you review the redemption trace for potential accidental double-issue or misuse?
sara-se: on it. pulling logs now. Can you pls confirm the IP that redeemed it (we'll redact in thread) and whether that redemption looks like an automated test runner?
jordan-billing: redemption IP is in our logs: 54.210.33.112 — belongs to CI infra for acme-apps (matches historical CI redeems). Looks like a teammate's CI job picked it up (common when tokens are in repos).
marco_lli: oh — yes, that token was briefly in a deployment script accidentally. my bad. if you can credit the account that's perfect.
jen-support: cool — since it's an accidental CI redemption and you're the org owner, we can approve a manual credit for $75. I will escalate to finance for the manual credit and add a note to revoke the consumed token so it can't be reused.
jordan-billing: filed manual credit request (#CR-2026-439). ETA 24 hours for processing. Applying temporary 75 USD credit to your billing balance as a hold so you can complete checkout — should reflect within 30 minutes.
kevin-bot: [system] Billing hold of $75 placed on acct_0a9Z... by jordan-billing (ticket CR-2026-439).
marco_lli: thanks! seeing pending credit now. will let you know if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
jen-support: glad it worked — for prevention: recommend rotating tokens and keeping them out of CI env vars. we can also reissue a new token scoped to your org if you want.
marco_lli: yes please reissue a fresh token scoped to org, not global. thanks everyone.
jordan-billing: noted — will follow up in ticket with the new token details once finance clears. closing loop here in ~24h.
